title: IVG 2400 Reload Yellow Edition Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg - 4PK
description: Designed for use with the IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pod Kit, these IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pods offer a simple and efficient way to refresh your device with tropical and citrus-inspired flavours. Each pack contains four individual 2ml prefilled pods, delivering up to 2400 puffs per kit (depending on personal usage) while ensuring a smooth and consistent vape. The Yellow Edition features a bright and refreshing mix of tropical and citrus flavours, blending sweet, zesty, and cooling elements: Fresh Mint Menthol Mojito – A crisp fusion of fresh Mint, zesty Lime, and a cooling Menthol finish. Lemon & Lime – A tangy and zesty blend of Lemon and Lime for a balanced citrus vape. Pineapple Ice – Juicy Pineapple paired with a refreshing menthol exhale. Tropical Fruits – A vibrant mix of Mango, tangy Citrus, and other tropical fruit notes. Swapping pods is effortless—just replace an empty pod with a fresh one and continue enjoying your vape. Whether you're looking for an easy way to keep your device performing at its best or a simple alternative to disposables, these pods provide a mess-free and reliable vaping solution.
